title: LingxiLoop AI Observability
description: LingxiLit dashboard for OpenAI-compatible logical calls and every provider HTTP attempt.

total-cost.title: Total cost
total-cost.description: USD cost calculated from LINGXILIT_PRICING_JSON for the selected period.

config.query: WITH parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.start}}') AS start_time, parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.end}}') AS end_time SELECT round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cost'])), 6) AS cost_usd FROM otel_traces WHERE notEmpty(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) AND SpanName != 'lingxiloop.openai.http_attempt' AND Timestamp >= start_time AND Timestamp <= end_time

logical-error-rate.title: Logical error rate
logical-error-rate.description: Final failed model calls divided by all logical model calls.

config.query: WITH parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.start}}') AS start_time, parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.end}}') AS end_time SELECT round(if(count() = 0, 0, countIf(positionCaseInsensitive(StatusCode, 'error') > 0) * 100.0 / count()), 2) AS error_rate FROM otel_traces WHERE notEmpty(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) AND SpanName != 'lingxiloop.openai.http_attempt' AND Timestamp >= start_time AND Timestamp <= end_time

rate-limit-rate.title: 429 attempt rate
rate-limit-rate.description: HTTP 429 attempts divided by all provider HTTP attempts, including retries.

config.query: WITH parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.start}}') AS start_time, parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.end}}') AS end_time SELECT round(if(count() = 0, 0, countIf(toInt32OrZero(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']) = 429) * 100.0 / count()), 2) AS rate_429 FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'lingxiloop.openai.http_attempt' AND Timestamp >= start_time AND Timestamp <= end_time

rpm-utilization.title: Rolling RPM utilization
rpm-utilization.description: Every provider HTTP attempt in the last 60 seconds. 🟡 begins at 80%; 🔴 begins at 100%.

config.query: SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.name'] AS service, SpanAttributes['lingxiloop.provider.host'] AS provider, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] AS model, count() AS rpm, toInt64OrZero(any(SpanAttributes['lingxiloop.limit.rpm'])) AS rpm_limit, round(if(rpm_limit = 0, 0, rpm * 100.0 / rpm_limit), 2) AS utilization_pct, multiIf(rpm_limit = 0, '⚪ UNCONFIGURED', rpm >= rpm_limit, '🔴 >=100%', rpm * 100 >= rpm_limit * 80, '🟡 >=80%', '🟢 <80%') AS status FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'lingxiloop.openai.http_attempt' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE GROUP BY service, provider, model ORDER BY utilization_pct DESC, rpm DESC

tpm-utilization.title: Rolling TPM utilization
tpm-utilization.description: Successful logical input + output tokens in the last 60 seconds, joined to provider limits without double-counting retries.

config.query: WITH usage AS (SELECT TraceId, ResourceAttributes['service.name'] AS service, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] AS model, toInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']) + toInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) AS tokens FROM otel_traces WHERE notEmpty(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) AND SpanName != 'lingxiloop.openai.http_attempt' AND positionCaseInsensitive(StatusCode, 'error') = 0 AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE), provider_limits AS (SELECT TraceId, any(SpanAttributes['lingxiloop.provider.host']) AS provider, toInt64OrZero(any(SpanAttributes['lingxiloop.limit.tpm'])) AS tpm_limit FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'lingxiloop.openai.http_attempt' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE GROUP BY TraceId) SELECT usage.service AS service, provider_limits.provider AS provider, usage.model AS model, sum(usage.tokens) AS tpm, any(provider_limits.tpm_limit) AS tpm_limit, round(if(tpm_limit = 0, 0, tpm * 100.0 / tpm_limit), 2) AS utilization_pct, multiIf(tpm_limit = 0, '⚪ UNCONFIGURED', tpm >= tpm_limit, '🔴 >=100%', tpm * 100 >= tpm_limit * 80, '🟡 >=80%', '🟢 <80%') AS status FROM usage INNER JOIN provider_limits ON usage.TraceId = provider_limits.TraceId GROUP BY service, provider, model ORDER BY utilization_pct DESC, tpm DESC

token-usage.title: Token usage
token-usage.description: Provider-reported logical input and output tokens over time; cached tokens are not added a second time.

config.query: WITH parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.start}}') AS start_time, parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.end}}') AS end_time SELECT formatDateTime(toStartOfMinute(Timestamp), '%Y/%m/%d %H:%M') AS request_time, sum(toInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])) AS input_tokens, sum(toInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])) AS output_tokens, input_tokens + output_tokens AS total_tokens FROM otel_traces WHERE notEmpty(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) AND SpanName != 'lingxiloop.openai.http_attempt' AND positionCaseInsensitive(StatusCode, 'error') = 0 AND Timestamp >= start_time AND Timestamp <= end_time GROUP BY request_time ORDER BY request_time

cost-by-model.title: Cost by model
cost-by-model.description: USD cost by requested model for the selected period.

config.query: WITH parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.start}}') AS start_time, parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.end}}') AS end_time SELECT SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] AS model, round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cost'])), 6) AS cost_usd FROM otel_traces WHERE notEmpty(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) AND SpanName != 'lingxiloop.openai.http_attempt' AND Timestamp >= start_time AND Timestamp <= end_time GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

logical-latency.title: Logical latency percentiles
logical-latency.description: Complete SDK operation duration in seconds, grouped by service and model.

config.query: WITH parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.start}}') AS start_time, parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.end}}') AS end_time SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.name'] AS service, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] AS model, round(avg(Duration) / 1000000000, 3) AS average_s, round(quantile(0.50)(Duration) / 1000000000, 3) AS p50_s, round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1000000000, 3) AS p95_s, round(quantile(0.99)(Duration) / 1000000000, 3) AS p99_s FROM otel_traces WHERE notEmpty(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) AND SpanName != 'lingxiloop.openai.http_attempt' AND Timestamp >= start_time AND Timestamp <= end_time GROUP BY service, model ORDER BY p95_s DESC

streaming-latency.title: Streaming TTFT / TBT
streaming-latency.description: Time to first token and time per output token when reported by the provider instrumentation.

config.query: WITH parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.start}}') AS start_time, parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.end}}') AS end_time SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.name'] AS service, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] AS model, round(avg(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.server.time_to_first_token'])), 3) AS average_ttft_s, round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.server.time_to_first_token'])), 3) AS p95_ttft_s, round(avg(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.server.time_per_output_token'])), 3) AS average_tbt_s FROM otel_traces WHERE notEmpty(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.server.time_to_first_token']) AND Timestamp >= start_time AND Timestamp <= end_time GROUP BY service, model ORDER BY p95_ttft_s DESC

rate-limits-over-time.title: 429 attempts over time
rate-limits-over-time.description: Provider rate-limit responses, including attempts later recovered by an SDK retry.

config.query: WITH parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.start}}') AS start_time, parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.end}}') AS end_time SELECT formatDateTime(toStartOfMinute(Timestamp), '%Y/%m/%d %H:%M') AS request_time, count() AS attempts_429 FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'lingxiloop.openai.http_attempt' AND toInt32OrZero(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']) = 429 AND Timestamp >= start_time AND Timestamp <= end_time GROUP BY request_time ORDER BY request_time

configuration-gaps.title: Pricing and limit gaps
configuration-gaps.description: Models seen without pricing or provider-specific TPM/RPM limits.

config.query: WITH parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.start}}') AS start_time, parseDateTimeBestEffort('{{filter.timeLimit.end}}') AS end_time SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.name'] AS service, SpanAttributes['lingxiloop.provider.host'] AS provider, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model'] AS model, if(SpanAttributes['lingxiloop.pricing.available'] = 'true', 'priced', 'UNPRICED') AS pricing, if(SpanAttributes['lingxiloop.limit.configured'] = 'true', 'configured', 'UNCONFIGURED') AS limits, count() AS attempts FROM otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'lingxiloop.openai.http_attempt' AND (SpanAttributes['lingxiloop.pricing.available'] != 'true' OR SpanAttributes['lingxiloop.limit.configured'] != 'true') AND Timestamp >= start_time AND Timestamp <= end_time GROUP BY service, provider, model, pricing, limits ORDER BY attempts DESC
